newsitem.title: CHINA: China's biggest open-cast coal mine opens in Oct.
newsitem.headline: China's biggest open-cast coal mine opens in Oct.

text.p: The first-stage project of China's biggest open-cast coal mine will start operating in remote northwestern Inner Mongolia in October after seven years' construction, the China Business Times said on Friday.
The completion of the first phase project would see mining of 12 million tonnes of coals annually and have a production life of 15 years, the newspaper said.
Although China's coal market was weak, coal consumption was rising, it quoted a mine official as saying.
"The coal produced by our mine is high quality and if we price it rationally, it will be competitive and definitely bring us profit," the official said.
The official press has reported that China's coal market is oversupplied, has been facing slumping sales and falling prices since last August and will be hard-pressed to recover any time soon.
